From the Editor

A few words, before the photos.

This is a small magazine with exactly one subject, one cover star and one very biased editor. Every page was set by hand and run a little over budget, mostly on staring at the photographs for longer than strictly necessary. There were no other applicants for the role of favourite person.

yours, always,the editor
